description.description: A digital illustration featuring Donald Trump seated in a futuristic command center in space. He is pressing a large glowing red button. Multiple screens show orbital explosions and targets being destroyed by lasers. The background features a viewed Earth from orbit, satellites, and a nebula. Various military personnel are seated at consoles around him, and holographic symbols resembling the Space Force logo are visible.
